Lunatone

Rock Psychic

Hoenn · Generation 3

Lunatone is a Rock/Psychic-type Meteorite Pokémon first found in Hoenn (Generation 3). It stands 1 m tall and weighs 168 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (95), with a base stat total of 460.
